Self the line (S1)

es: Una línea consigo misma: sube sus genes y fija lo raro que tenga. Gastas 1 semilla y salen {n}.
en: A line crossed with itself: its genes go up and whatever it carries gets fixed. Costs 1 seed and gives {n}.
Backcross to the mother (BX)

es: Un híbrido tuyo con una de sus dos parentales: lo que sale tira a esa madre. Variedad nueva, con su número de retrocruce.
en: One of your hybrids with one of its two parents: what comes out leans to that mother. A new strain, with its backcross number.
Fix the line (IBL)

en: Select an already stable line {n} times in a row: it stops varying from plant to plant.

Selfing (S1)

es: La línea consigo misma: no entra nada de fuera. Sale más parecida a la madre y con sus rasgos más fijados.
en: The line with itself: nothing comes in from outside. What comes out is closer to the mother and its traits better fixed.
Backcross (BX)

es: Cruzas el hijo con su propia madre: lo que salga se parece mucho más a ella, y a la segunda vuelta, casi del todo.
en: You cross the offspring back to its own mother: what comes out looks far more like her, and on the second round, almost exactly.

en: Two selections in a row of the same stable line: it ends up fully fixed and all its plants come out alike.
